newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shares pulled down by select blue-chips.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shares pulled down by select blue-chips.

text.p: Weakness in select blue -chips such as State Bank of India, Reliance Industries, Hindustan Lever and Tata Engineering & Locomotive dragged Bombay shares lower in mid-morning trade, dealers said.
"The broader market has notched marginal gains, but weakness in the top index-stocks has put pressure on the market," said a dealer at a foreign brokerage.
By 1130 hours (0600 GMT), Bombay's top 30-share index was down 7.18 points, or 0.17 percent, at 4,174.30, off 4,202.32 -- the day's high.
